interface.shortDescription: Peer implementer for Codex: live-tree code default, opt-in ACP peer, verified handoff
interface.longDescription: Grok as a peer implementer for Codex CLI and the ChatGPT desktop app. Product default is integration=direct: live-tree edits for one-shot code (no consent gate). Auto and review are opt-in isolated worktrees. ACP peer is opt-in multi-turn (always external worktree; apply only at ready peer-stop). runMode is a separate security axis: hardened (default private home + sandbox) vs runMode direct (installed Grok CLI / normal home). Codex agents install via setup; trusted SessionStart only reconciles owned files. Canonical matrix: plugin/references/integration-modes.md. Every mode emits exactly one machine-readable JSON result envelope. Not affiliated with xAI.
defaultPrompt: Run the grok setup skill and summarize readiness.
Use the grok review skill on the current change set and report correctness bugs.

Use the grok code skill to implement a bounded fix in the current workspace.
